home.heroTitle: All your PDF tools in one place
home.heroSubtitle: Merge, split, compress, convert and protect PDF files right in your browser. Files are processed in memory and deleted instantly.
home.toolsSubtitle: Seven free tools that work on your phone, tablet or computer.
home.whySubtitle: Built for students, job seekers and small businesses who need a quick, trustworthy fix.
home.faqSubtitle: Short answers to the questions we get the most.

features.freeText: No trials, no watermarks and no account. Every tool is free for everyone.
features.noSignupText: Use every tool instantly. We never ask for an email address or password.
features.instantText: Your documents stay in memory while we work and disappear the moment you download.
features.mobileText: The layout adapts to phones, tablets and desktops, so you can finish a job anywhere.

steps.one: Choose a tool from the grid above and open it.
steps.two: Drop your file onto the upload area or tap to choose it.
steps.three: Press the action button and download the result.

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF
mergePdf.desc: Join several PDFs into one document and reorder them with drag and drop.

splitPdf.title: Split PDF
splitPdf.desc: Extract a page range or save every page as a separate PDF in a ZIP.

compressPdf.title: Compress PDF
compressPdf.desc: Shrink files to three levels, or to an exact size such as 200 KB.

imagesToPdf.title: Images to PDF
imagesToPdf.desc: Turn JPG and PNG photos or screenshots into one PDF document.

pdfToImages.title: PDF to Images
pdfToImages.desc: Export every page as a JPG or PNG and download them in a ZIP.

rotatePdf.title: Rotate PDF
rotatePdf.desc: Turn all pages or only the pages you choose by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

protectPdf.title: Protect PDF
protectPdf.desc: Add a password to keep a PDF private, or remove a password you know.

uploader.reorderHint: Drag a row or use the arrows to change the order.
uploader.maxFiles: You can add up to {{count}} files.

merge.title: Merge PDF files
merge.subtitle: Combine two or more PDFs into a single document, in the order you choose.
merge.success: Your merged PDF is ready to download.

split.title: Split PDF pages
split.subtitle: Keep a page range as a new PDF, or export every page into a ZIP archive.
split.modeLabel: How do you want to split?
split.modeAll: Every page as a separate PDF
split.successRange: Your PDF with the selected pages is ready.
split.successAll: Your ZIP with one PDF per page is ready.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.subtitle: Reduce the file size for email limits, government portals and job applications.

levelHints.low: Keeps text sharp. Best for forms and reports.
levelHints.medium: Re-compresses images. Recommended for most files.
levelHints.high: Smallest file. Text may become non-selectable.

compress.success: Your compressed PDF is ready to download.
compress.targetNote: Very small targets can lower the image quality so the file fits.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert images to PDF
imagesToPdf.subtitle: Combine JPG and PNG images into one PDF, keeping the order you set.
imagesToPdf.success: Your PDF from images is ready to download.

pdfToImages.title: Convert PDF to images
pdfToImages.subtitle: Save every page as a separate JPG or PNG and get them in one ZIP file.

formatHint.png: Lossless quality. Best for text and line art.

pdfToImages.success: Your ZIP with one image per page is ready.

rotate.title: Rotate PDF pages
rotate.subtitle: Fix sideways scans and upside down pages in a couple of taps.
rotate.success: Your rotated PDF is ready to download.

protect.title: Protect or unlock a PDF
protect.subtitle: Add a password to a document, or remove one when you know the password.
protect.passwordHint: Use at least 4 characters. Write it down, we cannot recover it.
protect.unlockHint: Enter the password that was used when the PDF was locked.
protect.protectSuccess: Your PDF is now password protected.
protect.unlockSuccess: The password was removed and your PDF is ready.
